C1.worst_defect: The hero carries three stacked text blocks of body copy: a 4-line centred paragraph with a parenthetical definition ('(Vendure is an open-source headless commerce framework)'), then the buttons, then another sentence ('Your own store needs the plugin…'). At 390 px the centred paragraph runs to 7 lines, so the buttons only appear after a long read.

C2.worst_defect: In the changelog, references such as '(ADR 0005)', '(ADR 0004)', '(#116)' and '(#117)' are plain unlinked text, so a reader cannot follow them to check the claim behind each entry.

C3.worst_defect: The 6,300 px quick start has no picture of the sign-in screen or of the synced order in the Vendure Dashboard. Step 8 is a nine-item lettered list (a–i), and 'Check it worked' is five text bullets, so a reader never sees what success looks like.

C4.worst_defect: The docs sidebar lists 'Quick start' twice, once under 'Docs / Live demo / Quick start' and again under 'Overview'. The Overview's 'Next steps' cards (Live demo, Plugin setup, Source on GitHub) leave out Quick start and push it down to the pager.
C4.where: docs.desktop.01 sidebar and Next steps; every docs page sidebar

C5.worst_defect: On the Overview, 'Next steps' is a row of three cards followed by a full-width, right-aligned 'Quick start >' pager card with the same border and fill. It reads as an orphaned fourth card whose text is aligned the other way.

C6.worst_defect: On phone, the ten feature cards stack into one column about 2,900 px tall (two and a half screens of identical grey boxes) before the comparison table. Docs paragraphs dense with code chips (8 chips in the step 4 role sentence) raise the line height into a ragged rhythm.

C7.worst_defect: llms-full.txt is ordered alphabetically and opens with '# At the till' rather than Overview and Quick start. Docs pages carry only BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, with no article type.
C7.where: text/endpoint_llms_full_txt.txt first lines; tech.json docs.* jsonLd

overall_worst.defect: The docs landing page's 'Next steps' block has three cards plus a full-width, right-aligned pager card in the same style, which reads as a stray fourth card. The step the reader needs most, Quick start, sits only in that pager card, while Plugin setup gets a primary card, and Quick start also appears twice in the sidebar.
overall_worst.fix: Make Quick start the first 'Next steps' card, with Live demo, Plugin setup and GitHub in a 2x2 grid, and give the prev/next pager a distinct borderless style. Drop the duplicate 'Quick start' from the sidebar's top link group.
